chunks: (Saleh) said: "O people, why do you wish to hasten evil rather than good? Why not ask for God's forgiveness? You may well be forgiven."
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Saleh say to his people about hastening evil versus good?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Al-Naml, Prophet Saleh challenges his people's impatience for divine punishment, interpreting their rush toward evil as a precursor to hasty retribution. Shia exegesis highlights this as a call to proactive repentance (istighfar) to secure Allah's mercy before the inevitable arrival of His wrath. The verse underscores the theological principle that seeking forgiveness is the key to unlocking divine compassion.
